briefdescription.para: Stages an edit of an existing file.

detaileddescription.para: The planned bytes come from the diff.
The planned content is the diff itself, so the planned bytes are built one time and are not stored again. The executable bit is read from the target file. The target is marked as existing.

parameterdescription.para: The file that the transaction writes.
The document before the edit. Must not be null.
The line-level diff that produces the planned bytes.
The index of this file in the transaction. It names the blob file.

briefdescription.para: Stages an undo entry.

detaileddescription.para: The planned document is the content that the undo writes.
The original document is the content that the undo replaces. An undo entry has no diff, so the planned document is stored. Both documents must not be null.

parameterdescription.para: The file that the undo writes.
The content of the file before the undo.
The content that the undo writes.
The executable bit that the undo entry recorded.
True when the target exists before the write. False when the undo creates it.

Returns the path of the file as the user sees it.

simplesect.para: The original bytes. The view is valid while this staged file lives.

briefdescription.para: Returns the bytes that the transaction writes.

detaileddescription.para: For an edit, the bytes come from the diff. For an undo entry, they come from the planned document.

simplesect.para: The planned bytes. The view is valid while this staged file lives.

briefdescription.para: Reports the executable bit that the record stores and that a created target gets.

simplesect.para: True when the executable bit is set.

briefdescription.para: Appends the unified diff from the original bytes to the planned bytes.

detaileddescription.para: An undo entry has no diff, so the diff is computed here with Myers.

parameterdescription.para: The text that receives the unified diff. Nothing is appended when the diff holds no changes.

briefdescription.para: Writes the planned bytes, with a swap of the target and its blob when the target can be swapped.

detaileddescription.para: A swappable target is exchanged with its blob, so that the blob keeps the original bytes for the undo. When the pair cannot be swapped, the original bytes are written to the blob, and the target is then replaced directly.

parameterdescription.para: The transaction whose blob file is used.

simplesect.para: Status result paired with true when the target may have changed, so that restore is needed.

briefdescription.para: Writes the bytes that the file had before the transaction.

detaileddescription.para: An existing target that can be swapped is exchanged with its blob. Before the exchange, the blob takes the metadata of the target and the current time. Otherwise the planned bytes are written to the target.

parameterdescription.para: The transaction whose blob file is used.

simplesect.para: Status result paired with true when the target may have changed, so that restore is needed.

briefdescription.para: Returns the target to its original bytes after a commit or an undo changed it.

detaileddescription.para: A file that the transaction created is deleted, once its planned bytes are checked. A blob that holds the original bytes is exchanged with the target. A blob that holds neither the planned bytes nor the original bytes is a failure. Otherwise the original bytes are written to the target, once the target is checked to hold the planned bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The transaction whose blob file is used.

simplesect.para: Ok when the target holds the original bytes, otherwise the failure.

briefdescription.para: Checks that a file holds the expected bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The bytes that the file must hold.

simplesect.para: Ok when the bytes match. A file that cannot be read gives the read failure with the display path. Other bytes give the failure text::Diagnostics::failChecksumMismatch.

briefdescription.para: Exchanges the target with a blob file, then checks the bytes of the blob and the target.

detaileddescription.para: After a successful exchange, the blob must hold the original bytes. When it does not, the exchange is reverted, and the failure is returned with true unless the blob then holds the planned bytes. The planned bytes of the target are checked after the exchange, and a failure there reports true.

parameterdescription.para: The blob file to exchange with the target.

simplesect.para: Nullopt when the pair cannot be swapped. Otherwise the status paired with true when the target may have changed.

briefdescription.para: Writes the planned bytes to the target, without a swap.

detaileddescription.para: An existing target must hold the original bytes first. A new target must not exist. The executable bit is set only for a new target.

simplesect.para: Status result paired with true when the write may have changed the target.

briefdescription.para: One target file of a transaction, with its original bytes and its planned bytes.

detaileddescription.para: A commit and an undo write the planned bytes. A restore brings the original bytes back. Each operation reads both byte sets from the documents and the diff that the staged file owns.
